decisions.reason: Adding dashboard and email winner notifications does not change the Big Block prize amount, trigger, eligibility, funding, or ticket-reset mechanics.
Adding dashboard and email winner notifications does not change the Small Block prize amount, sales interval, funding, eligibility, or ticket-reset mechanics.
Notification channels do not alter the Chainlink VRF selection method, eligible population, fairness, or on-chain verification behavior.
Winner notification is distinct from prize delivery, and the candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing automatic direct wallet transfer and removing obsolete claim behavior.
Winner notifications do not change the requirement to expose prize-pool values through unauthenticated public APIs.
Notification channels do not change how tickets are allocated when a mint has no referral code.
Notification channels do not change the trigger, recipient, quantity, or lifecycle of referral-earned prize tickets.
The existing message-184 FAQ MODIFY already records that prize winners are notified through the dashboard and email, so no addition or correction is required.
Winner notifications do not change the separate Small Block and Big Block ticket counters or their reset behavior.
Adding notification channels has no necessary effect on Aave-based prize-pool yield generation or its unresolved lifecycle status.
Winner notifications do not change the referral code's mint-number identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The ebook reader behavior is established by a separate clause in the same message; winner notification channels do not change its read-only mode, PDF.js technology, or entry points.
